components.name: Recipe Plate
components.description: A label-first vault tile: vermilion monogram, slab-caps title, visibility chip.
components.html: • GGrandma's Cornbreadprivate
components.css: .ds-plate { list-style:none; background:#f3ede1; border:1.5px solid #16302a; border-radius:14px; box-shadow: inset 0 1.5px 0 rgba(255,255,255,0.6), 0 14px 26px -14px rgba(6,18,15,0.55); } .ds-plate a { display:flex; flex-direction:column; align-items:flex-start; gap:10px; min-height:148px; padding:18px 18px 16px; text-decoration:none; color:#182b25; border-radius:14px; transition: transform 0.1s ease, box-shadow 0.14s ease; } .ds-plate a:hover { transform:translateY(-3px); } .ds-plate-mono { font-family:'Zilla Slab',Rockwell,serif; font-weight:700; font-size:2.6rem; line-height:1; color:#d6431f; } .ds-plate-title { font-family:'Zilla Slab',Rockwell,serif; font-weight:700; font-size:1.2rem; line-height:1.12; text-transform:uppercase; letter-spacing:0.01em; margin-top:auto; } .ds-chip { font-family:'Zilla Slab',Rockwell,serif; font-size:0.7rem; font-weight:600; text-transform:uppercase; letter-spacing:0.07em; color:#333024; background:#ddd2bb; border:1px solid #16302a; border-radius:999px; padding:2px 10px; }

components.name: Action Button
components.description: The one committing control per view (New recipe, Cook Mode).
components.css: .ds-btn-action { font-family:'Zilla Slab',Rockwell,serif; font-weight:600; font-size:0.9rem; text-transform:uppercase; letter-spacing:0.05em; cursor:pointer; padding:10px 18px; border-radius:10px; background:#d6431f; color:#fdf3ec; border:1.5px solid #b53514; box-shadow: inset 0 1.5px 0 rgba(255,255,255,0.28), 0 5px 14px -5px rgba(214,67,31,0.7); transition: transform 0.08s ease, box-shadow 0.12s ease, background 0.12s ease; } .ds-btn-action:hover { background:#b53514; transform:translateY(-1px); } .ds-btn-action:active { transform:translateY(1px); box-shadow: inset 0 2px 5px rgba(0,0,0,0.28); }

components.name: Neutral Button
components.description: Secondary actions (Edit, Sign out, Delete): a bone enamel key.
components.css: .ds-btn { font-family:'Zilla Slab',Rockwell,serif; font-weight:600; font-size:0.9rem; text-transform:uppercase; letter-spacing:0.05em; cursor:pointer; padding:10px 18px; border-radius:10px; background:#f3ede1; color:#182b25; border:1.5px solid #16302a; box-shadow: inset 0 1.5px 0 rgba(255,255,255,0.6), 0 4px 10px -4px rgba(6,18,15,0.4); transition: transform 0.08s ease, box-shadow 0.12s ease; } .ds-btn:hover { transform:translateY(-1px); } .ds-btn:active { transform:translateY(1px); box-shadow: inset 0 2px 5px rgba(0,0,0,0.28); }

narrative.overview: A family's recipes are the everyday enamelware of a shared kitchen: sturdy bone plates racked on a deep spruce-green pantry wall, made to be used and handed down, never precious. The whole product lives on one saturated green ground; content rides on rimmed bone enamel surfaces; and a single vermilion signal marks the one action that commits. It is warm and domestic without softening into the cream-paper recipe magazine, and structured and confident without cooling into a gray dashboard. The world was chosen against a hard brief: neither corporate, nor trendy, nor clinical, nor twee. The saturated green and industrial signage lettering keep it from SaaS grays and of-the-moment editorial serifs; the bone plates and the human provenance stamp keep it from feeling like a lab; and the sturdy slab type keeps warmth from curdling into country-kitchen kitsch.
keyCharacteristics: A deep enamel-green ground owns the whole surface; bone plates carry all content.
Sturdy slab signage (Zilla Slab) in caps for every title, label, and control.
Exactly one vermilion signal, reserved for the committing action.
Physical depth: a dark rim plus an inner highlight, lifted by one soft shadow.
Provenance shown as a stamped maker's mark, not a footnote.

rules.name: The One Signal Rule
rules.body: Vermilion is only ever the committing action, at most one per viewport. It is never decoration; when it appears, it is the thing to press.

rules.name: The Wall Rule
rules.body: The enamel green owns the ground and chrome. Content does not float on it inside a container without becoming a bone plate; only plain running text sits directly on the wall, in bone.

rules.name: The Tinted-Secondary Rule
rules.body: Secondary text is tinted from the green, never neutral gray. Gray on this world reads as an accident.

rules.name: The Sign Rule
rules.body: Every title, label, and control is Zilla Slab in caps. A title shrunk to a timid mixed-case label has left the world; the type carries the composition.

rules.name: The Enamel Edge Rule
rules.body: Depth is a rim (dark keyline + inner highlight) plus one soft shadow. Never a zero-blur block shadow; this world is enamel, not neobrutalism.

dos: Do reserve vermilion (#d6431f) for the one committing action in a view; everything else is bone, green, or tin.
Do set every title, label, and control in Zilla Slab caps; keep titles at sign scale.
Do give every surface the enamel rim (dark keyline + inner highlight) and lift it with one soft shadow.
Do tint secondary text from the green.
Do theme the browser surfaces (selection, caret, scrollbar, focus ring, accent-color) from the palette.
donts: Don't put more than one vermilion action in a viewport, or use it as decoration.
Don't reach for cream/parchment grounds or delicate display serifs; that is the category default this world refuses.
Don't use folksy script or heavy speckle; warmth here is sturdy, not saccharine.
Don't use glass, blur, gradient text, or zero-blur block shadows.
Don't float content directly on the green inside a container; make it a bone plate.
